notes: Ethereum mainnet engine-only launch of ChessEngineV5 as committed, with no constructor arguments. Its choose, play and playAny entry points are pure; there is no owner, admin or initialization step. The rule libraries are compiled into the engine and require no separate deployment. Solidity 0.8.26, Cancun, optimizer enabled with 200 runs and via_ir = true produce 23,339 runtime bytes (23,365 initcode bytes, 1,237 under the EIP-170 limit) as rebuilt from this tree with forge 1.8.3; the figure grew from 22,268 with the accepted promotion-threat and mate-guard revisions recorded in ADAPTATION.md. The engine has no link references: Bitboard, Chess, Rules and Strength are internal libraries inlined into its bytecode. The complete engine/rules tests and corpora are retained. The hook is reserved for a separate later launch.
